correctness.rationale: The residue set is sumfree modulo 5f+1, while the prefix interval plus the residue set is exactly its complement. Together with explicit finite transition sumsets, this proves both admissibility of every listed term and rejection of every omitted term. Boundary cases f=3,4 and the minimal periods are handled separately.

originality.rationale: The inspected 2026 preprints prove families through g<=2f and conjecture the period lengths more generally. Searches for S_{f,2f+1}, g=2f+1, 5f+1, and equivalent strict-greedy formulations did not identify a prior theorem giving this family or its exact closed membership formula.

value.rationale: The theorem establishes the first complete parameter strip immediately beyond the proved diagonal, confirms the conjectured minimal periods there, and gives an exact residue formula and density.
